title: Checkpoint
subtitle: B1 · Unit 6: B1 · Connect reasons, results and points of contrast

steps.prompt: Which connector most directly introduces a consequence?
When does afin de + infinitive fit?
options: The event happened before another past event
steps.explain: Use afin de + infinitive when the subject stays the same.
Toutefois qualifies or contrasts with the previous point.

steps.prompt: Why should survey evidence be qualified?
options: A personal story proves every claim
The sample may not represent everyone
steps.explain: A limited sample supports a limited conclusion.

steps.prompt: Which wording avoids claiming an unmeasured result as certain?
options: Le changement pourrait réduire les retards.
Le changement réduit toujours les retards.
Le changement a été prouvé sans mesure.
steps.explain: Pourrait marks a possible result rather than an established fact.
